name: LAB · Continuous enhancement — remove its source
description: Inspect the Wolf, execute Dismiss at an empty friendly position, then inspect the lost aura.

name: LAB · Continuous weakening — remove its source
description: The Basilisk weakens an orthogonally adjacent enemy. Dismiss removes it and restores power.

name: LAB · Dynamic friendly population
description: Play another Wolf and inspect the Alpha increasing without a permanent modifier.

name: LAB · Classification-based scaling
description: Play the Honeybee; only its Insect classification qualifies for the Swarm.

name: LAB · Enhanced-creature scaling
description: The enhanced Wolf qualifies before dynamic bonuses. Play Gift and inspect each layer.

name: LAB · Weakened-enemy scaling
description: Play Claw and compare the enemy weakening with the Gloom scaling contribution.

name: LAB · Reactive weakening chain
description: Bruise weakens other friendly creatures. Chorus reacts to real other-creature weakening once per turn.

name: LAB · First enhancement and a multi-step chain
description: Gift enhances Firstlight; its first enhancement grants adjacent allies a permanent bonus.

name: LAB · False-to-true threshold
description: Gift raises the Sentry to its power threshold, drawing and fortifying once this match.

name: LAB · Power crossing event
description: Gift crosses the configured threshold. Inspect the structured previous/new power event.

name: LAB · Captured variable sacrifice power
description: Replace the enhanced Wolf with Flytrap; half the captured power is rounded down.

name: LAB · Conditional protection disappears
description: Ward protects the neighboring Wolf while fortified. Rust removes that qualification.

name: LAB · Conditional weakening immunity
description: Selfward is immune while fortified. Rust removes its continuous protection.

name: LAB · Destruction history and immutable power
description: Reaper destroys an enemy. Scavenger scales with history while Reaper uses captured power.

name: LAB · Claimed territory reactions
description: Play a Wolf to expand into neutral territory; Border reacts only to a successful claim.

name: LAB · Row-winning score bonus
description: Inspect ordinary row power and the separate Herald bonus. Play another card to compare.

name: LAB · Position score bonus
description: Marker survives at row 1 / column 0. Inspect the separate card points.

name: LAB · Combined AND / NOT conditions
description: A second friendly creature makes the condition true. Inspect the fortification/draw chain.

name: LAB · Branching and multi-stage evolution
description: Evolve the Wolf into Star Wolf; the later Imperial form replaces its dynamic ability with a row aura.

name: LAB · Resurrection counter and reaction
description: Grave restores a friendly Wolf. Keeper observes the real resurrection.

name: LAB · Fortified territory and token aggregation
description: Inspect the token-derived scaling and fortified-territory score independently.

name: LAB · Draw and generation events
description: Generator creates a Wolf and draws a card; Scribe observes both successful events.

name: LAB · Explicit opt-in derived power reaction
description: Adding a friendly creature changes derived power; this card explicitly reacts to dynamic changes.

name: LAB · Safe current-power aggregate
description: The Sum reads eligible creatures before dynamic scaling, so it cannot recursively count its own bonus.

name: LAB · First weakening event
description: Bruise weakens Dusk; its first successful weakening grants fortification once this match.

name: LAB · Returned creature reaction
description: Recall returns the enemy Wolf; Keeper reacts to the successful zone change.

name: LAB · Incoming replacement targeting
description: Replace Offering with Flytrap. The sacrificed creature boosts the incoming replacement through its captured identity.

name: LAB · Destroyed context remains exact after resurrection
description: Reaper destroys the enemy test creature, which resurrects and then targets its exact destroyed instance.

name: LAB · Sacrificed context remains exact after resurrection
description: Replace the test creature with Flytrap. It resurrects elsewhere, then targets its original sacrificed identity.

name: LAB · Captured and lost territory reactions
description: Player Two places a Wolf at A5 to capture A4. Border observes the real loss and fortifies remaining friendly territory.
